values.binNote: The wiki's secondary (AoE) damage is not a separate bin data value; it is the primary Maximum Physical Damage (JinxR#DamageMax flat 200/350/500, ad ratio 1.2, missing-hp coef 25/30/35%) multiplied by JinxR.AoEDamageMult=0.8, giving flat 160/280/400, ad ratio 0.96, and missing-hp coef 20/24/28%. No single bin row states these multiplied numbers directly.

The wiki's minimum secondary damage is derived by taking the Minimum Physical Damage (JinxR#DamageFloor flat 20/35/50, ad ratio 0.12, missing-hp coef 25/30/35%) and multiplying by JinxR.AoEDamageMult=0.8, giving flat 16/28/40, ad ratio 0.096, and missing-hp coef 20/24/28%. No bin row states these multiplied numbers directly.

mechanics.claim: The rocket only detonates and deals damage upon colliding with an enemy champion, so the damage instance occurs on impact, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: fires a massive rocket in the target direction, ... and exploding upon colliding with an enemy champion

mechanics.claim: Spell shields do not block the explosion's damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the explosion.

mechanics.claim: Once the missile is in flight, the flat base damage stays fixed at the rank it was cast at even if the ability is leveled up before it hits; only the bonus AD ratio still updates with AD changes between cast and hit.
Enemies other than the primary target caught in the explosion radius take only 80% of the calculated damage.
mechanics.quote: Enemies surrounding the primary target take 80% damage.

mechanics.claim: The missing-health bonus damage is calculated from each individual hit unit's own missing health, not the primary target's missing health.
mechanics.quote: The bonus damage based on missing health is based on each unit's own missing health and not the primary target's.

mechanics.claim: Total damage scales up the longer the rocket travels, reaching maximum only after 1500 units of travel (about 0.85s); this does not affect the missing-health bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Super Mega Death Rocket!'' deals {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|10 to 100 for 16|0 to 1500}} damage. This does not affect the '''bonus''' damage based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
